p: But didn’t Tamar become pregnant from the first act of intercourse, … said: … Tamar broke … with her finger

But didn’t Tamar become pregnant from the first act of intercourse, despite the fact that she was a virgin at the time of her sexual act with Judah? Rav Naḥman said: Tamar broke her hymen with her finger
All of those … from the household of Rabbi … who break … are named Tamar
All of those women from the household of Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi who break their hymens are named Tamar
And why are they named Tamar? … on account of Tamar, … who broke … with her finger.
And why are they named Tamar? They are called this on account of Tamar, who broke her hymen with her finger.
But weren’t there Er and Onan, … Er and Onan engaged in sexual intercourse in an atypical manner,
But weren’t there Er and Onan, her previous husbands, who presumably engaged in sexual intercourse with her? The Gemara responds: Er and Onan engaged in sexual intercourse in an atypical manner,
